bihermann.name: Hermann Monument
bihermann.slogan: A copper giant raising his sword over the Teutoburg Forest.
bihermann.line: The statue stands 27 metres tall on a 21-metre column, and took from 1888 to 1897 to build.

biexternsteine.name: Externsteine
biexternsteine.slogan: Sandstone needles older than the legends told about them.
biexternsteine.line: Its Descent from the Cross, carved about 1160-1170, is the oldest monumental relief cut into natural rock north of the Alps.

bisparrenburg.name: Sparrenburg
bisparrenburg.slogan: Bielefeld's hilltop fortress, with 285 metres of tunnels below.
bisparrenburg.line: Its casemates run 285 metres underground, and the tower alone survived the 1944 air raid on Bielefeld undamaged.

bipaderdom.name: Paderborn Cathedral
bipaderdom.slogan: A 93-metre tower where Charlemagne once held court.
bipaderdom.line: The Three Hares window shows three hares sharing three ears, though each appears to have two.

bikaiserpfalz.name: Kaiserpfalz Paderborn
bikaiserpfalz.slogan: Where an emperor and a pope once shared a table on the Pader.
bikaiserpfalz.line: In 799 Pope Leo III met Charlemagne at Paderborn, seeking his help after being driven from Rome.
